summary: The recorded base reproduces false acceptance because the five reported classes set accuracy_mmlu_threshold while TestMMLU reads accuracy_mmlu and defaults to 0.00. The exact candidate renames all five declarations without changing their values, and both its regression and independent threshold-boundary checks pass.
